changes: A ride's bends: lean, apex speed, radius and speeds in and out of each, the bends braked at the apex or with the throttle snapped open while leant over, and a diagram of the grip the ride used
Maintenance reminders of your own: every so many kilometres or months from the last time a job is logged, whichever comes first, with a notification when it is due

A cold engine warning (Settings, off by default): "Engine still cold" in the helmet when you rev the engine while the coolant is still cold, above 4,500 rpm and below 70 °C unless you set other limits

Google Maps directions in Italian are checked on real rides now. Two of Maps' Italian wordings are read from the text too, not only from Maps' arrow: a roundabout called "rotatoria" and a sharp turn ("Svolta tutto a sinistra")

The bike's yaw, roll and pitch rates are shown in degrees a second, turned into the bike's own directions like the accelerations: the IMU sits at 45°, so the yaw rate read about a third too low and the roll rate was half yaw. The third rate, unnamed until now, is the pitch rate. Rides already recorded show the new figures too
No more "Battery is not being charged" right after starting the engine: the voltage read a moment before the start, with the engine still off, was taken for the charging voltage

The 12 V battery log takes a reading only once the engine has been off for half an hour, and none while the starter turns. It used to keep the 13-14 V of a bike just switched off, and the dip of a start
Readings above 13.6 V already in the battery log are left out: no battery rests that high, they were charging voltages

Maintenance: the dash's reminders now show the kilometres left and where they fall ("in 11,045 km (at 16,597 km)"). The distance the dash keeps counts down, and KawaNav took it for the odometer the service is due at
A maintenance reminder the dash keeps switched off is marked "reminder off"

The curve on the dash no longer flips back and forth from one second to the next (Sharp right, Right, Sharp right; a bend and the straight arrow in turn; two bends just after a roundabout). A bend that comes up is still shown at once
With two Kawasakis paired with the phone, KawaNav connects to the one "Start automatically" is set up with, no longer to the first one it finds. It waited for the other bike for ever
The app uses Google's Material icons
Switching tabs fades smoothly instead of the jumpy system animation
Settings → About → "Export the log" copies KawaNav's log to Download/KawaNav, to send with a problem report. It used to be in the debug build only
Changing riding mode, power, KTRC, KQS and the dash shift lamp from the Bike tab has been tried on a Z900: the cards no longer say it is untested

Every recorded ride checks the clutch: under Engine, whether it held in hard accelerations. When the engine revved too high for the gear in two of them or more, a notification says the clutch may be slipping (Settings → "Clutch warning" turns it off)
Nothing changes for riding: the normal app is the same as 1.2.3. This version adds a tool for testers

Debug build: Settings → Bike data → "Field tests" lists what is still to be tried at the bike (the ride settings and shift lamp on a real dash, what the traction control and ABS values mean …), with the steps for each and a mark for the ones done

Debug build: the same screen works out from your latest rides how much slower the rear wheel turns than the front, and whether the engine runs ahead of the rear wheel under full throttle, the first step towards a slow-puncture and a clutch-slip warning

A recorded ride now ends about 20 seconds after the bike is switched off. It used to wait 5 minutes, or for ever when KawaNav had been opened by hand. Settings → "End a ride" can keep it going 5 or 15 minutes instead, so that a fuel stop stays in the same ride
When the bike drops out while riding, the ride waits at least 5 minutes for it before ending

After KawaNav was stopped during a ride (Stop in the notification, or by itself after the bike was switched off), the record button stayed red and "Stop ride" did nothing. It now goes back to green when KawaNav stops, and the ride is saved as before

A ride's average fuel economy is now the distance over the fuel burned. It used to average the seconds, so a second at walking pace counted like one at 120 km/h and the figure came out a third or more too high (23 km/L where the fuel says 17)
On a bike that sends no fuel counter, like the Z900, a ride now shows the fuel used and the L/100 km, estimated from the instant fuel economy and marked ≈. Idling is not in it
The riding log's total consumption counts only the rides that know their fuel, no longer all the kilometres
Ride settings: before sending, the confirmation lists every value next to what the bike has ("Power: Full", "KTRC: 2 → 1"), since they all go to the bike in one write
A ride setting you changed is marked "changed", "Send to the bike" waits until something would change, and "Back to the bike's values" puts the pickers back
Picking Sport, Road or Rain sets power and KTRC to that mode's own values, as in Rideology (Sport Full / KTRC 1, Road Full / KTRC 2, Rain Low / KTRC 3); a Rider mode keeps yours
Changing power or KTRC away from Sport, Road or Rain turns the riding mode into Rider, with a note saying why, so your own values always go as Rider
Power and KTRC sit under the riding mode they belong to, with where they come from ("Sport: Full power, KTRC 1" or "Your own: Rider"); the quickshifter and the name come after, apart
Ride-settings profiles, as in Rideology: save riding mode, power, KTRC and the quickshifter under a name on the phone, then pick a profile to fill it in and send it
With "Beeps instead of words", a speed camera now sounds like a two-tone siren (high-low, high-low, in both ears), so it can no longer be taken for the two beeps of a sharp bend

The bike's screen can change riding mode, power, KTRC, the quickshifter and the dash shift lamp in the normal app too, not only in the debug one. This has not been tried on a bike yet: check the dash after sending
The ride-settings and shift-lamp cards say why a write was not sent, and what came of it: no answer, refused, or the settings the bike reads back

The mail icon on the dash also lights for WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Threema, Outlook and Samsung's messages and mail, and a WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal call lights the call icon. Notifications that stay on ("WhatsApp Web is active", a backup) light nothing
The ride settings can carry a name, as Rideology sends the title of a setting. Whether the dash shows it is not known yet

Spoken curve warnings: KawaNav can say the coming bend in your helmet, like "Sharp bend left" or "Hairpin right", about 6 seconds before it at your speed and once per bend, with or without navigation. Settings → "Spoken curve warnings" picks hairpins only, sharp bends and hairpins, or all curves; "Hear a curve warning" plays one to set the volume
"Also when too fast" says any bend with "slow down" when you come at it faster than your pace takes it: Relaxed, Normal, Sporty or Fast. If you are already slowing down enough, it stays quiet
"From my rides" takes the pace from your recorded rides: the lean you usually reach in a bend, from your last 20 rides once they hold 30 bends
A bend right after the one said is named with it: "Hairpin left, then sharp bend right"
"Beeps instead of words": the warnings beep in the ear of the bend's side, one beep for a bend, two for a sharp one, three for a hairpin, higher when you are too fast
"Say speed cameras": with the camera warnings on, each camera is also said in the helmet ("Speed camera ahead, limit 50") or beeped
The warnings go by the bike's own speed while it is connected, which has none of the GPS delay

A ride's chart can be zoomed: pinch or double-tap to look at a stretch closely, move along it with two fingers, and the corner button shows the whole ride again. Zoomed in, the scale follows what is shown and the rest of the track on the map is faded
The track on the map takes the colours of the value picked for the chart, from blue where it was lowest to red where it was highest, and the note under the map says which values the colours stand for

A ride's track is drawn over an OpenStreetMap map: pinch or double-tap to zoom in, drag to move around, and the corner button shows the whole ride again. Settings → "Map under the track" turns the map off

A ride shows more of what it recorded: the torque as three lines on one chart (asked by the throttle, by the engine control, given by the engine), the roll and yaw rates, the GPS speed, the rear wheel's slip, the wheelie angle, the fuel use, the suspension speeds and the raw brake values, when the bike sends them

A ride's summary has more rows: the body's accelerations, the lean either side, the wheel and GPS speeds, the instant fuel economy, the roll and yaw rates and the rear wheel slip, the time in each gear, and how many gear changes there were and how many the quick shifter made
Rides are safer: if the app is killed while it compresses a finished ride, the ride is kept whole instead of being lost
Offline maps of the individual US states can be downloaded again (their names contain a "/", which broke the download)
Home shows "no GPS track" while a ride runs without a GPS fix, instead of the missing track turning up only in the ride list afterwards

Turns are shown correctly again: a street name no longer changes the arrow ("Rampart Street" was read as a ramp, "Emergent Avenue" as a merge), and a roundabout exit is taken from the part of the instruction that names it
A Bluetooth packet the meter sends cut short is ignored instead of reading as a lean of about −100° or a gear of 15 for a second
Turning KawaNav off clears the dash first (arrow, distance, phone battery icon) instead of leaving the last arrow on the meter
A call or message that arrives while KawaNav is not connected to the bike is shown on the dash as soon as it connects again
An automatic start now says what is missing if the "Nearby devices" permission was revoked, instead of doing nothing
A ride that is still being recorded is marked in the ride list and cannot be deleted until you stop it
A ride whose track could not be recovered after a restart says "track lost" instead of reading as a ride that recorded 0 samples
An offline-region download that Android stops because it ran too long says so and can be started again, instead of taking the app down with it
The first-start guide no longer skips a question if the app is closed while it is on screen: the same step comes back
The phone battery icon on the dash no longer shows an empty battery just after connecting: the level comes from Android's battery broadcast, and no icon is sent until there is a real reading
A new version is offered when you open the app, not only after the phone restarted
The Bluetooth device chosen for autostart (helmet intercom, headset, …) always starts KawaNav when it connects, also within the hour after you stopped it by hand
Ride distance uses the odometer and the GPS together: no more 1 km steps, and closer to the real distance
Rides saved before are worked out again when you open them or the riding log: their distance and average speed may change a little
A second ride recorded without restarting the app no longer starts with a jump in distance
No more −60 °C oil (or −40 °C coolant and intake) in the first seconds after connecting; such values in older rides are ignored
The instant fuel consumption's "no value" (102.3) is no longer recorded
Battery warnings no longer fire on one low reading while the fuel pump primes or just after a start, and can be turned off in Settings
The bike screen's total time is shown in hours and minutes: the dash reports minutes, not hours
The phone battery icon on the dash no longer flashes a low or unknown battery when Android briefly gives no reading
The bike's average and instant fuel economy can be shown in km/L, L/100 km, MPG US or MPG UK (L/100 km by default)
KawaNav is now a joint project of Darthbob and jackyes, with jackyes' features merged in
New look after Rideology: bottom bar with Home, Bike, record button, Rides and Settings; dark and light theme
Your bike: odometer, trips, fuel and range, battery voltage, temperatures, maintenance reminders and live values; the last values stay after the ignition is off, with "Walk to the bike"
Ride recording: GPS track and the bike's values, riding log with totals and records, ride summary with charts, export as Rideology CSV, GPX or all values
Refuel diary, 12 V battery log and maintenance log
Speed camera warnings from the offline map data (off by default)
Call and message icons and the clock on the dash (off by default)
Ride settings of the bike (riding mode, power, traction control…) shown in the app
In-app updates: KawaNav offers new versions with the list of changes and installs them (Android asks to confirm)
"What do the options mean?" under "Which curves count": explains each option and which arrow the dash shows
Shorter README with simpler install steps
Phone battery on the dash: 4 bars and charging, like with Rideology
Headset icon on the dash while your helmet intercom is connected
Warning in the app when the dash does not support turn-by-turn
Stop with autostart set up no longer reconnects after a few seconds
Pairing the bike in KawaNav is now tested: Rideology is not needed
First release: Google Maps directions and upcoming curves on the dash, autostart, offline maps
